name: Dharani Achari (Chari)
tagline: Handcrafted Custom Artworks, Portraits & Creative Drawings
bio: I am Dharani Achari (Chari), an independent visual artist and founder of Chari Creations. I specialize in realistic pencil portraits, deep charcoal studies, bespoke customized portraits, vibrant colour pencil drawings, and detailed hyper-realistic artworks. With over 6 years of dedicated practice, I transform beloved memories and loved ones into timeless, personalized artworks.

materials.tools: Staedtler Mars Lumograph, Faber-Castell 9000, Tombow Mono Zero Eraser, Strathmore Bristol Board
Willow & Vine Charcoal, Carbon Pencils, Blending Stumps, Kneaded Erasers, Archival Textured Fine Art Paper
Faber-Castell Polychromos, Prismacolor Premier, Caran d'Ache Luminance, Heavyweight Cotton Paper
Carbon Pencils, Graphite 9B, Blending Stumps, Electric Erasers, Archival Bristol Smooth Paper

processSteps.title: Select Medium & Reference Photo
processSteps.description: Choose your medium and size, and upload your reference photos. If you're unsure which photo works best, Chari will personally guide you on lighting, clarity, and composition.

processSteps.title: Initial Proportion Sketch
processSteps.description: The foundation of realism begins with an accurate outline sketch. A preview is shared with you to confirm likeness, expression, and layout before any shading begins.

processSteps.title: Deep Layering & Rendering
processSteps.description: Hours of patient layer-by-layer shading, texture mapping, and skin pores / hair details. Regular behind-the-scenes progress photos/videos are shared with you on WhatsApp.

processSteps.title: Protective Seal & Safe Packaging
processSteps.description: The final drawing is sealed with protective fixative to prevent fading and smudging. Safely packaged in rigid multi-layer protective packaging and dispatched with live tracking.
